title: Standard-Ewald crash in Inverse_Matrix.hpp:117
symptom: The strict-2D full-Ewald path crashes during the Coulomb-matrix inversion, reported at Inverse_Matrix.hpp:117, or produces an indefinite full matrix.
root_cause: The legacy split-Ewald full-matrix assembly suffers large-number cancellation between the Ewald terms for an isolated 2D material, making the matrix strongly indefinite or singular and the inversion unstable.
minimal_fix: Switch to the direct_mixed_fourier positive-Gram output by setting out_librpa_2d_coulomb_method direct_mixed_fourier (with out_librpa_reader_version 1, rpa 1, exx_ewald_dimension 2, and the direct ecut/kz/gamma order controls). Do not use eigenvalue clipping or cut Coulomb.
validation: Verify librpa_2d_coulomb_method.dat says version 1 / direct_mixed_fourier, exactly one complete reader-v1 full matrix per IBZ q representative, finite entries, Hermitian to roundoff, no materially negative eigenvalue.
avoid: Using the legacy Ewald route for an isolated 2D material when the matrix is strongly indefinite; masking the crash with clipping or a smooth inverse.
